chapter_title_en: The Iron Shears of Elder Yuan
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 506: The Iron Shears of Elder Yuan – Ji Ning's New Mentor
chapter_meta_description: Seamless Gate assassins target Ji Ning, only to be frozen by a mysterious old gardener. Elder Yuan reveals himself, kills them with shears, and offers Ji Ning a priceless lesson in Heartforce.
og_title: Desolate Era: Ji Ning Meets the Mad Gardener, Elder Yuan
og_description: Elder Yuan, a top Daofather, slaughters Seamless Gate elites with gardening shears, then offers Ji Ning a shocking new master-disciple relationship.
twitter_title: Desolate Era - Ji Ning Gets a New, Insanely Powerful Master
twitter_description: Elder Yuan snips True Immortals to death with shears and then calls Ji Ning 'dense' for not using Heartforce better. A new powerup is coming!

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme, eccentric Daofather born from the primordial chaos. He is the leader of the 'Four Ancestors of the River Yuan,' a neutral faction so powerful that both major camps of the Three Realms court their favor.

surfaces: Four Ancestors of the River Yuan
lore_anchors.definition: A group of four immensely powerful Daofathers and sworn brothers, with Elder Yuan as their leader. Their neutrality makes them a pivotal political force in the Three Realms.
A treasure born from primordial natural forces, possessing a spiritual nature. It is a tier above even supreme-grade Pure Yang treasures and can choose its own master.

A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power. It is extremely difficult to apply to the physical body but can exponentially increase the power of techniques and evasion.
A famous Immortal in Chinese mythology, here depicted as the treasured disciple of the Daoist leader. His name is used to illustrate Elder Yuan's terrifying level of impunity.
